name: Ota

routes.outcome: Official Ota City urban-planning map page. It provides static planning-map PDFs/images and explicitly warns that the map is not guaranteed or certifying cadastral evidence; no parcel API or cadastral polygon layer is exposed.

Official Ota City cadastral-survey implementation page. It lists survey implementation/results notices and identifies the city Rural Development Division, National Land Survey Section as contact. This is local custodian/procedure evidence, not a live parcel service.

Official Ota City results-viewing notice. It says 2024 fiscal-year field-attendance results for parts of Kasukawa, Izuka, and Nitta-Shimoeda were available for related land-rights holders to inspect in person at Ota City Hall during a stated period. No downloadable geometry or anonymous query endpoint is provided.

Official Ministry of Justice notice states that nationwide electronic registry-office map data is publicly released through the G-Space Information Center, with updated data extracted in February 2026. The notice describes a download channel and data specifications; it does not provide a city-specific anonymous query endpoint in the page inspected.

Anonymous HTTPS page retrieval succeeded; page HTML exposed only static urban-planning map assets and contact links. No JavaScript/configuration for a parcel viewer or ArcGIS/OGC parcel service was present in the inspected page.
Anonymous HTTPS page retrieval succeeded; cadastral-survey notices and local contact were readable. No parcel geometry endpoint, schema, or safe native parcel identity was returned.

Anonymous HTTPS page retrieval succeeded; local results-viewing scope and dates were readable. The page provides an image of an area location map, not full parcel polygons, and no machine-readable parcel response.

Anonymous HTTPS page retrieval succeeded; official national publication route confirmed. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS-verification exception used. No individual parcel geometry was downloaded or retained.
